title: Testing Permission-Aware Retrieval for RAG across Vector Stores and Authorization Engines: research artifact (pre-registrations, evidence, raw outputs and evaluated code)
description: Pre-registrations with dated amendments, run evidence, raw outputs, vendor reproducers, the LaTeX source and the wardowl library at the commits the runs used, for the preprint "Testing Permission-Aware Retrieval for RAG across Vector Stores and Authorization Engines". Start with REPRODUCE.md, which maps every table and figure of the paper to its run, script and data, and states what was not rerun. evidence/ARTIFACT_GAPS.md lists what is missing and why. Prepared corpora and embeddings are left out: the corpora's terms limit redistribution, and rebuilding them from their sources has not been tested. The author develops wardowl.
notes: This record holds material under different terms; LICENSE.md is the full statement. Code: MIT. Text and data the author produced: CC BY 4.0. The paper's text and figures under paper/: no license is granted until the preprint is posted. Third-party material in the raw outputs stays under its own terms and is for non-commercial research only: text from FiQA (non-commercial use only, per its site), and answers generated by Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (Qwen Research License Agreement, non-commercial means research or evaluation). The prepared MS MARCO corpus artifacts are left out; the raw outputs of the MS MARCO experiments that were sampled hold identifiers, not MS MARCO text. The record-level license below is Other (Non-Commercial) because the record as a whole cannot be offered on broader terms than its most limited part.
